button.$description: v0.9 — Component-bound tokens for the Button. Five sizes (xs/sm/md/lg/xl), five intents (primary/neutral/danger/ai/success) × five surfaces (solid/tonal/outline/ghost/glass), three shapes (rect/pill/round), full state matrix (rest/hover/focus/active/loading/disabled/selected/success). See ADR 0016 and 00-foundations/buttons.md.

xs.$description: v0.9 — 24 px table-row inline action / chip-close. Desktop-density only; below the 44 px touch floor.

sm.$description: 32 px — compact toolbar / dense-form button. Linear/Carbon operator default. Desktop-density only.

cozy.$description: v0.8 — 36 px settings-panel sweet spot. Density tier between sm and md.

md.$description: 40 px — Lumen Button default. Comfortable for trackpad + desktop.

lg.$description: 48 px — mobile primary / modal CTA / full-width form submit. Hits the 44 px touch floor with margin.

xl.$description: v0.4 — 56 px hero pill CTA. Marketing + AI-action primary.

padding.$description: v0.9 — `space.inset.squish.*` per size (x > y). Composed pattern from Atlassian / Curtis 2016. Pill shape adds +0.5x to horizontal inset.

xs.$description: 8/0 px — xs (24 px button, no vertical inset because height = label + icon).

md.$description: 16/8 px — md (40 px button) — Lumen default.

xl.$description: 32/16 px — xl (56 px hero pill CTA). Reads as 'CTA-spaced'.
12 px — icon-to-label gap on xl. Slightly looser to match the hero scale.

rect.$description: Default rect button radius — ~6 px. Operator default; matches Linear/Notion.

pill.$description: Full pill (9999 px). Opt-in via shape='pill' for hero / AI / marketing CTAs.

round.$description: Round IconButton — squared dimensions + full radius.

icon.$description: v0.9 — Per-size icon dimensions. Each tier picks an icon size that pairs with the label ramp (size at +1 over the type tier).

md.$description: Override — 14 px (~13 px label + 1) — see button.tsx for the explicit size mapping.

lg.$description: 16 px icon on 48 px button (label is 14–15 px).

xl.$description: 20 px icon on 56 px hero pill (label is 16–18 px).

label.$description: v0.9 — Per-size label type tokens. Tied to typography.tokens.json via type.label.{sm,md,lg} for now; will migrate to type.button.* once the type system grows that surface.

xl.$description: 16 px label on xl. Hero scale.

intent.$description: v0.9 — Five intents define ROLE (color/voice). Compose with surface to get the visual variant (intent × surface).

primary.$description: Primary action — the single most important thing in a view. Lime fill + accent.fg text + soft glow ladder. WCAG AAA contrast (12.6:1).

secondary.$description: Secondary action — outline pill or rect, hairline ink. Same height + padding as primary; only fill + border differ.

tertiary.$description: Tertiary action — alias of ghost surface (kept for backwards compat). New code uses surface='ghost'.

ghost.$description: Ghost — no chrome at rest, subtle hover tint. Used in toolbars / table-row actions / nested controls.

danger.$description: v0.9 — bg deepened red.500→.700 to clear AA Normal (4.5:1). White text on #c92626 = 5.2:1.

danger-soft.$description: v0.9 — danger × ghost (Carbon's `danger-ghost` pattern). Destructive in tight contexts (table-row delete) where solid red over-emphasizes.

ai.$description: v0.9 — AI-action variant. Tonal lime + sparkle leading icon + idle 1 px shimmer border. Sparingly: only on AI-driven primary actions (Improve, Summarize, Suggest, Quote-with-AI).

success.$description: v0.9 — success-affirmation. Brief 1.6 s state of any button after async confirmation (Saved, Booked, Quoted). Tonal lime + checkmark icon + verb-confirmed label.

selected.$description: v0.9 — aria-pressed=true state for ToggleButton / Segmented / split-button menu trigger. Subtle lime tint + lime hairline border.

glass.$description: v0.9 — translucent glass surface for floating overlays (toolbar pinned over a map, modal scrim toolbar). backdrop-filter: blur(12px). NOT a default primary.

focus.$description: v0.9 — Focus indicator — dual-ring on lime accent surfaces, single-ring on neutral surfaces. Atlassian 2024 pattern (single-color ring fails 3:1 on same-colored surface).

neutral.$description: Other intents — single ring (3 px lime alpha at 32% on neutral bg passes 3:1).

motion.$description: v0.9 — Decelerate-not-bounce. No transform/scale on press. Press feedback = bg color shift + filter brightness(0.92) + glow ladder shrink.

hover-out.$description: 80 ms color/border ease-in. Faster than fast — reads as immediate 'release'.

success.$description: 260 ms checkmark transition; the 'Saved' label persists 1.6 s, then the success state exits at 80 ms.
